sources.scope: Actual portable compatible-agent workflow with native/source-module adaptation, not DisCo CLI/model execution.

construction.method: User-approved native Metal/C++ and isolated source-Python adaptation; stable-ID lanes, integrated graph, assertion cases and create/verify stages. Required-backend block disables automatic admission.

applicability.scope: Pinned Splash representation, planning, state/serving and verification investigation; common discovery does not qualify a different Mac/model/backend.
applicability.prerequisites: Access to the pinned representation/planning, serving-cache or qualification route; native checks need matching Apple/backend/model resources, an authorized workload and frozen semantic/measurement controls.
applicability.input_contract: Source/build, macOS/device, target and compatible draft artifacts/formats, tokenizer/template/vision selection, context/cache/memory controls, KV/recurrent precision, ANE and verifier-row policy, concurrency/priority/sampling, quality controls and cache state.
applicability.produced_artifact: An execution-identity report with observation, source-backed invariant, alternate explanation, smallest discriminating check, actual result and unresolved Metal/ANE/model/disk-state gap.
applicability.failure_modes: Treating an API alias as new weights, equal bit width as loader/kernel compatibility, or a fixed seed as fixed cache/batch/adaptive-verification scheduling can invalidate the comparison; CPU cache/codec checks do not prove GPU state.
applicability.refusal_point: Stop at unsupported formats, unavailable backend/model resources, unsafe service exposure or the authorized budget.

limitations: Required Metal/ANE/model/actual device and disk-state execution remains BLOCKED_REQUIRED_BACKEND; Python policy/codec checks do not clear it.
Service performance, quality, native recurrent-state recovery and skill efficacy remain unverified.
Only selected bodies were mined; not all formats, kernels, supported devices or release/client workflows.
NO_LICENSE is the actual unauthenticated GitHub CLI resolver fallback, not a legal conclusion; Apache-2.0 and third-party notices are retained.
recommendations: Resolve representation, memory/cache owner, validity key and reclaim/rollback boundary before tuning a numeric control.
Freeze semantic and workload controls beyond the seed, and retain actual-path fallbacks, admission waits, evictions, cancellations and errors.
Inspect options without starting the normal serve path, which can download target/draft weights; installation and serving require separate task authority.
